entities.summary: Andreas Aurifaber was a German physician of some repute, but through his influence with Albert of Brandenburg, last grand-master of the Teutonic Knights, and first Protestant duke of Prussia, became an outstanding figure in the controversy associated with Andreas Osiander whose daughter he had married. Andreas Aurifaber was a physicians & medical pioneers from Wrocław (1513-12-09, Wrocław–1559-12-22). Holds notable historical significance, documented across 0 language editions of Wikipedia.
